reviewBasis.referenceScope: July illustration controls head only; no exact camera/dimensional metrology.
reviewBasis.independentVisualInspection: Neutral same-camera before/after renders were inspected against the July head-only reference; root reviewer also inspected camera A and the reference.

observations: The expanded Cere root transition reads as an oversized, isolated angular plaque on the forehead instead of an integrated bill-root surface. It worsens the brow-to-cere construction relationship seen in the reference.
The broader orbital brow is visible, but four changed surfaces cannot form the reference’s long, connected sweep from upper orbit/crown into the bill bridge and integrated cheek arc.
The lower-jaw opening remains visually open in both neutral camera views; no collision or clearance validator was run on this candidate.
integrationDecision: Do not integrate this candidate. Preserve it as a held proposal; it has no GLB, runtime route, or artistic acceptance.

minimumMeaningfulScopeExpansion.reason: A single connected construction transition needs coordinated adjacent root geometry. Changing the four current brow/cere surfaces alone produced a detached plaque.
